selectedAssets.alt: Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze-blue, pearl-pink, ruby-ivory, and emerald RAZE looks wear rainbow knee-high hosiery and pumps with geometric star waist panels before Chisinau's Valea Morilor Cascade Stairs.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and emerald RAZE looks wear rainbow thigh-high stockings and pumps above the winding Raut River and pale cliffs at Orheiul Vechi while the women at left share a cheek greeting.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze, pale blue, ruby, and cobalt RAZE looks wear rainbow thigh-high stockings and heels beside the Dniester River, with Soroca Fortress and soft distant industrial glow behind them.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze, pale rose, teal-black, and plum RAZE looks share a warm linked pose on a wetland observation deck above Lake Beleu in four tall branded statement boots.
